translations.source_sense_description: Vogeljagd: Falle für Singvögel; ein gefangener Vogel, der andere Vögel anlocken soll

glosses: A person or object meant to lure somebody into danger.
A real or fake animal used by hunters to lure game.
Deceptive military device used to draw enemy attention or fire away from a more important target.

examples.text:
2002, Robotech: Battlecry – Guide and Walkthrough
Just every 5 seconds or so shoot out a decoy near the Cats Eye and the enemies will aim for that instead of the Cats Eye.

glosses: An assembly of hooped or netted corridors into which wild ducks may be enticed (originally by tame ducks) and trapped.
To lead into danger by artifice; to lure into a net or snare; to entrap.

examples.text: to decoy troops into an ambush; to decoy ducks into a net
E'en while fashion's brightest arts decoy, / The heart, distrusting, asks if this be joy.

glosses: To act as, or use, a decoy.

examples.text: As they were being decoyed, the rescue team carried the hostage and quietly slipped away.
